# v1.0 (macOS 15 Sequoia): legacy mode

> Experimental, AI-written, tested on one laptop (ASUS GA403WM). Kernel code: it can panic. Back up first.
> **macOS 15 Sequoia only.** For macOS 26 Tahoe use the latest `v2.*`.

Copied from [ga403wm-hackintosh `v1`](https://github.com/thanhnndev/ga403wm-hackintosh/releases/tag/v1) (2026-10-13), Wi-Fi files only.
The binaries are unchanged; `SHA256SUMS.txt` was regenerated for this subset.

| File | What |
|---|---|
| `itlmt7925.kext.zip` | MT7925 driver, **legacy mode**: shows up as Ethernet; inject your network into its `Info.plist` ([guide §5](https://github.com/thanhnndev/mt7925-macos-wifi/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md#5-legacy-mode-ethernet-style)) |
| `ItlWiFi.app.zip` | menu bar app: scan, join, speed test |
| `LICENSE`, `LICENCE.mediatek` | licenses |

Superseded by `v1.1` (adds the native Wi-Fi front end).
